articles.title: Rochdale Borough Council awards £152,500 contract for Lowerplace Primary School water pipework
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Borough Council has awarded a £152,500 contract for hot and cold water pipework at Lowerplace Primary School to M&R Heating Services Northwest Limited.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Borough Council has awarded a £152,500 contract for hot and cold water pipework at Lowerplace Primary School to M&R Heating Services Northwest Limited. This contract is part of a two-phase project aimed at upgrading the school's water infrastructure.

The contract was published on the Find a Tender service and is expected to enhance the school's facilities, ensuring better access to water services for the pupils and staff.

This development follows similar contracts awarded for other schools in the borough, including Boarshaw Primary School and Whittaker Moss Primary School, which also received funding for their water pipework upgrades.

The Boarshaw project was awarded to J C Mills & Son Limited for £230,000, while Whittaker Moss's second phase was awarded to W.H. Good Limited for £150,000.

These upgrades are part of Rochdale Borough Council's ongoing commitment to improving educational facilities across the area. The council aims to ensure that all schools meet modern standards for health and safety, particularly in essential services like water supply.

How Lowerplace is affected

  • The £152,500 contract will improve water services at Lowerplace Primary School.
  • Similar contracts have been awarded to other schools in Rochdale for infrastructure improvements.
